Paste the text you are going to read…
Open the camera when the overlay starts
So nobody notices you are reading

• Drag the box with the ⋮⋮ icon until it sits right next to the front camera hole.
• The narrower the box and the fewer the lines, the less your eyes move: 2 or 3 lines work well.
• Small text and a steady speed keep your eyes almost still.
• Step back a little from the phone; the farther away, the less the angle shows.
• Tap the text to pause or resume, and drag it to move through the script.
Permission to draw over other apps
To show the script on top of the camera app, Android needs you to enable “Display over other apps” for Discreet Prompter.
The script floats over the camera. Tap the text to pause.

Hi, and welcome to this video. In under two minutes I am going to tell you why this idea can change the way you look at your finances.

First of all: you do not need to be an expert. You only need three simple concepts, and I will explain them right now.

The first one is time. The second is consistency. And the third, the one almost nobody applies, is patience.

Stay until the end, because I will leave you a real example with numbers.
